title: Devilman
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Gentle teenager Akira Fudo merges with the demon Amon at the urging of his friend Ryo Asuka and fights demons as Devilman. Ryo is revealed to be Satan, and his televised exposure of Devilmen sets off worldwide paranoia in which a human mob kills Miki and her family; the story ends with humanity nearly extinct, Akira dead and God's angels descending. Seven Seas published the original in two volumes in 2018; rating to verify.
life_message: It warns that fear and hatred can make humans more monstrous than demons, and holds up love as what makes one human.

content.note: Graphic demon fights, mob murder of Miki and her family, near-extinction war; protested by PTAs (Wikipedia; AniList Gore and Body Horror tags).

Mass hysteria and Akira's despair and loss of faith in humanity (Wikipedia; MangaUpdates Bullying).
Mob violence and witch-hunts shown as horrific (Wikipedia).

delivery.evidence: Jason Thompson (ANN) calls it emotionally powerful, with the blurred line between humans and monsters as a major point; not called preachy

delivery.note: Its warning that hatred makes humans monstrous is carried by events, especially the mob's killing of Miki's family.

winners_losers: No one wins: Akira, Miki and nearly all humanity die, and Satan grieves too late as God's angels descend. Sympathy goes to Akira and to demons who are not wholly evil, while the human mob and God receive the harshest view.
